answer: Anyone who burns aliases faster than the churn cap simply runs out of replacements, and the replacements it does make inherit the fable history. Churn is counted in gale, and onyx publishes the ratio each epoch. At most 18% of an operator's declared identities may be replaced in one epoch, which means rotating keys to dodge slashing does not reset the record. The attacker spends 75 dollars and 1 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
